So relation: "instance of", object: "editorial entity". subject_type: "organization". object_type: "organization type".

4. Biblioteca Ayacucho - "managed by" Fundación Biblioteca Ayacucho. relation: "managed by". object: "Fundación Biblioteca Ayacucho". subject_type organization, object_type organization.

5. Biblioteca Ayacucho - "named after" Battle of Ayacucho. relation: "named after". object: "Battle of Ayacucho". subject_type organization, object_type event.

6. Battle of Ayacucho - "date of occurrence" December 9, 1824. relation: "date of occurrence". object: "9 December 1824". subject_type event, object_type date.

7. Battle of Ayacucho - "participants" Spain. relation: "participant". object: "Spain". subject_type event, object_type country.

8. Battle of Ayacucho - "participants" territories of the Americas. Could be "American territories". We'll use "participant". object: "Territories of the Americas". subject_type event, object_type region.

9. Battle of Ayacucho - "result" prior to full independence of the continent. Not a clear relation. Maybe "significance". Could skip.
